title: Test relative FOSB signal in Finnish WG-6 endometrium within run and cycle phase
question: Across shared native run and histologic phase strata, is the FOSB signal percentile higher in eligible endometriosis cases than controls?
scope: One eligible native assay per donor, exact HumanWG-6 v2 physical probe identity, full 48,701-address reference and recorded false hormone-medication field. Use complete shared strata with fixed case and control counts.
steps: Publish the outcome-blind single-probe plan and complete the prerequisite chip census.
Verify native source pins, donor and assay selection, overlap, physical addresses and finite signals.
Compute the equally weighted stratum contrast, exact two-sided stratified permutation test and leave-one-stratum-out range.
deliverables: Public prospective plan, reusable offline analysis, synthetic regression tests, independently checked aggregate results or documented blocker.
acceptance: Use at least two shared chip-verified run-by-phase strata and report cohort accounting.
Require exactly one finite native AVG_SIGNAL at every one of 48,701 manifest addresses per selected assay.
Verify the effect, deletion range and exact permutation counts independently and report measurement and exchangeability limits.
